title: Screen shield

status.insecure: This build uses an insecure service address, so the shield is off.
status.on: On. Tap the doll on anything suspicious.
status.off: Off. Turn it on to check what is on your screen.

steps.overlay: Step 1 of 3: allow "Display over other apps", then come back to $t(common:appName).
steps.notifications: Step 2 of 3: allow notifications so Android keeps the shield running.

needs.title: What the shield needs
needs.overlay: Allow "Display over other apps" so the doll can float over other apps.
needs.notifications: Allow notifications so Android keeps the shield running.
needs.capture: The first time you tap the doll after you turn on the shield, Android asks to share your screen. Tap Start now. $t(common:appName) takes a picture only when you tap the doll. Turn off the shield to stop sharing.
needs.privacy: The screenshot goes to the check service only to be checked. It is not saved.

body: A small doll floats over other apps. Tap it on a job post, chat or listing and $t(common:appName) checks what is on your screen.

errors.notStarted: The shield did not start. Check that "Display over other apps" is allowed and try again.
errors.failed: The shield did not start. Try again.
errors.checkFailed: The check did not start. Turn the shield on and try again.

tile.title: Quick settings
tile.body: Turn the shield on or off from the quick settings at the top of your screen.
tile.added: $t(common:appName) shield is in your quick settings.
tile.failed: Could not add it. Edit your quick settings and drag $t(common:appName) shield in.
tile.hint: Swipe down from the top, tap the pencil to edit, and drag $t(common:appName) shield into your quick settings.
